article.title: Elon Musk loses first round against US's first AI "Nudification" ban
article.summary: ALBAWABA - A federal judge on Friday refused to halt the first-in-the-nation statewide ban on fake AI-generated nude photos in Minnesota at an early stage of the case, meaning the rule would remain in force as Elon Musk’s xAI pursues a constitutional challenge.Minnesota says the rule is tightly tailored to prevent the dissemination of non-consensual sexual material made by AI, while xAI says the policy violates free speech rights under the U.S. Constitution, according to Reuters.U.S. District Judge Donovan Frank denied xAI’s request for a preliminary injunction against the statute, which went into force Aug. 1.The regulation prevents website owners, software developers and others from permitting users to utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to digitally “undress” photos of identifiable people.Frank said xAI had not shown it would be harmed in its attempt to sue over the new regulation, arguing it violates the First Amendment by curtailing protected expressive activities.“...
